   * ICD-10-CM for all medical visits, inpatient and outpatient.
   * ICD-10-CM for epidemiological purposes.
   * ICD-10-CM for workers who may be receiving workers compensation.
   * ICD-10-CM for routine claims.

## OSHA
   * OSHA 301
   * 300 log
